sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Killa is a Scav Boss in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: Killa earned his reputation back in the days of the Contract Wars, when he and his crew took over the ULTRA shopping mall. For most locals, that mask with the three stripes means death. For a select few, it's a reminder of wild dubstep parties somewhere on the city's edge.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Killa has different health values than PMCs and Scavs.
| Stats |
| Head: 70; Thorax: 210; Stomach: 170; Arms: 100 each; Legs: 120 each; Total: 890 |
- Instead of the typical 4 single slot pockets, he has 5 double slot pockets, bringing their total space to 10 slots.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Killa needs to be killed once each for the quests The Huntsman Path - Sellout and The Huntsman Path - Relentless.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: Killa can be found on the following locations:

sections.heading: Interchange
sections.text:
- In the IDEA, OLI and Goshan stores in the ULTRA shopping mall
- Around the center stores on the first and second floor of the ULTRA shopping mall

sections.heading: Terminal
sections.text: In the medium container ship berths area. Note: Killa is only 1 of 5 possible bosses to spawn each raid.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text: Killa uses a light machine gun or other automatic weapon to suppress the enemy, while lurking from cover to cover, getting closer to his target for the final push. During the assault he moves in a zig-zag pattern, uses smoke and fragmentation grenades, and relentlessly suppresses enemies with automatic fire. He will follow his target large distances out of his patrol route, so be sure to run very far to get away from him if he has locked onto you.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
It is recommended to avoid being spotted by Killa. He has multiple grenades and is generally accurate with his bursts. If you are close to him he will continuously push the player and relentlessly hunt them until he ambushes and assaults them. It is best to attack him with high-penetration ammunition such as 5.45 BS, 5.56 M995, or 7.62x51. Without proper ammunition to kill him, shredding his 6B13 M to low durability or firing solely at his legs are both appropriate, albeit more risky, strategies. Grenades generally won't work to kill him, as he is a highly mobile fighter and will rarely be pinned down long enough for a grenade to stop him. If fighting him with a teammate, attacking him from two different directions and peeking cover is a sound strategy, as he will continue to suppress one of his opponents while the other can safely return fire.

It is extremely important to utilize cover and stay mobile when fighting him, and to always be mindful of one's ammo count—if he's armed with his RPK-16, he will likely outgun the player with his 95-round drum mag and supplementary AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazine.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- Killa's shirt is available for PMCs as Adik tracksuit upper-body clothing.
- Killa is the older brother of Tagilla, the boss on the Factory location.
- According to Jaeger in The Huntsman Path - Sellout, Killa was a former athlete.
- A cosplay with a more Russian-focused theme of the character "Tachanka", a Spetsnaz operator from the game "Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Siege" that was posted on Reddit, inspired the developers to create Killa. Tachanka is known for his iconic Maska-1SCh helmet.
